subject: Associating data with a set of trees using %<+%

messages.author: e06f011f759cb053
messages.subject: Associating data with a set of trees using %<+%
parts:
Hi,
Thanks for a great tool! I am wondering if there is a way to associate data with tree tips for a set of trees with identical tips?
For example, I have a multiphylo list of trees and would like to plot each, associating metadata with the tips, so that tip colors are the same for each tree. This works on a single tree, but I cannot figure out how to associate metadata with a multiPhylo class object. 

Any suggestions would be great. Thank you!

ggtree(trees) + 
  facet_wrap(~.id,  ncol=2, scale = 'free') +
  theme(legend.position="right")  %<+% meta + 
  geom_tippoint(aes(color=year), alpha=0.5, size = 2)

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: Associating data with a set of trees using %<+%
parts:
For multiPhylo, you cannot use %<+% directly.
However, associating data to a set of trees is possible with the tidytree package.

Try the following code:


x <- ape::rmtree(3, 5)
d = data.frame(label = paste0('t', 1:5),
    type = sample(letters[1:3], 5, replace=T))

require(tidytree)

trees <- lapply(x, function(y) {
 full_join(as_tibble(y), d, by='label') %>% as.treedata
})

class(trees) <- 'multiPhylo'

require(ggtree)
require(ggplot2)

ggtree(trees) + 
  facet_wrap(~.id) +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color=type), size = 3)



Bests,
Guangchuang
